return_trips_view.definition:
SELECT r.id AS route_id,
    r.organization_id,
    r.route_number,
    r.route_date,
    r.plan_trip_id,
    r.status AS route_status,
    r.driver_id,
    d.full_name AS driver_name,
    r.carrier_id,
    c.name AS carrier_name,
    s.country_id,
    (count(rt.id))::integer AS total_returns,
    (count(rt.id) FILTER (WHERE ((rt.status)::text = 'received'::text)))::integer AS received_returns,
    (count(rt.id) FILTER (WHERE ((COALESCE(rt.status, 'pending'::character varying))::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['received'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying])::text[]))))::integer AS pending_returns,
    max(rt.return_date) AS last_return_at,
    ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM tbl_return_forms f
          WHERE (f.route_id = r.id)) AS forms_count
   FROM (((((tbl_routes r
     JOIN tbl_stores s ON ((s.id = r.store_id)))
     JOIN tbl_dispatch_guides g ON ((g.route_id = r.id)))
     JOIN tbl_returns rt ON ((rt.dispatch_guide_id = g.id)))
     LEFT JOIN tbl_drivers d ON ((d.id = r.driver_id)))
     LEFT JOIN tbl_carriers c ON ((c.id = r.carrier_id)))
  GROUP BY r.id, r.organization_id, r.route_number, r.route_date, r.plan_trip_id, r.status, r.driver_id, d.full_name, r.carrier_id, c.name, s.country_id;
